cards.name: Scrying Peek
cards.desc: Before the flip, glimpse your own top card (reveals it face-up early). Pure information; does not change deck order.

cards.name: Rank Surge
cards.desc: After the flip, add +2 to the rank of your revealed card for this round's comparison only (does not persist on the card).

cards.name: Tie Thief
cards.desc: If this round is a tie, you win the pot outright instead of triggering a WAR.
